the BPS saturation of a monopole is not a trivial consequence of finiteness of a theory, as it was the case for kink and the BPS monopole of the N = 1 supersymmetric Yang– Mills theory, and the N =2 BPS monopoles.

the N = 1 and N = 2 theories are not the end of the road for BPS-saturated solitons, but the N = 3 and N = 4 theories are also amenable to this treatment.
